description: Split a PDF into several files of N pages each (1 = one file per page), written into a folder. Returns the list of files.

output_dir.description: Folder for the parts. Defaults to a new folder beside the input named <file>-split.

pages_per_file.description: Pages in each output file. Default 1.

password.description: Password for a PDF that asks for one when opened. Used only on this machine.

name: split_pdf
title: Split PDF
